snippet.title: The Anomaly Manor - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
There's a mansion with a dark legend: Whoever enters disappears forever. Equipped with your spectral camera, you decide to delve inside to investigate. Locate and photograph the anomalies to escape before the wandering souls catch you!

The Anomaly Manor is now available on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3921510/The_Anomaly_Manor/

The Anomaly Manor is a game about anomalies. You'll be trapped in a haunted house, and to escape, you'll have to search for various anomalies on each level and photograph them. If you do it right, you'll be closer to the exit, but if you do it wrong, the house could trap you forever.

And you won't be alone. As you progress, the adventure will become more dangerous, as the trapped souls will be drawn to your presence. Be careful!

Can you escape and discover all the secrets in The Anomaly Manor?
